bio: This cozy Gainesville spot from husband-and-wife duo Grace Glennon and Kyle Spor focuses on breakfast and lunch, served with a side of comfort. Whether ordering from their to-go window or opting for dining room or patio seating, you are guaranteed a meal prepared with heart, as everything is made in house. The all-day menu features comforting classics with a contemporary edge, like biscuits and gravy and specials like pastrami grilled cheese. Be sure to sample the crispy potatoes topped with onion cream, garlic confit, fresh herbs and lime. Try the perfectly toasted club sandwich, with tender roasted turkey, bacon, cheddar, lettuce and ranch dressing. Although they do offer wine and other beverages, opt for a coffee from their own roast collection.
